documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Manaksia Steels Limited reported record financial performance for FY 2025-26, crossing the H1,000 Crore revenue milestone for the first time with revenues reaching H1,053.19 Crore. The operational improvement was driven by the commissioning of the new 1,10,200 TPA Alu-Zinc coating line in June 2025 and the capacity augmentation of the existing colour-coating line. Management outlined ambitious expansion plans, including a new 90,000 TPA colour-coated line expected to be completed in FY 2026-27 and a H100 Crore investment in a 6-Hi Reversible Cold-Rolling mill targeted for December 2027. Consequently, the company set consolidated revenue targets of H1,500 Crore for FY 2026-27 and approximately H3,000 Crore for FY 2028-29. Manaksia Steels Limited reported its financial and operational performance for FY 2024-25 in its Annual Report 2025, detailing revenues of Rs 584.18 Crore and undertaking major capacity expansions in Alu-Zinc and colour-coated steel lines funded entirely through internal accruals.

guidance.claim: The management stated that the new integrated Alu-Zinc production line would result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year.
guidance.quote: The first expansion programme will comprise the addition of the Company’s new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 1,10,800 TPA, which would result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year.

guidance.claim: The colour coating line expansion is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.
guidance.quote: This investment is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of Galvalume, galvanized, and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings, and industrial infrastructure.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of Galvalume, galvanized and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings and industrial infrastructure

capex_expansion.claim: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore comprises the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line that will enhance capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line. This will enhance the Company’s manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that EBITDA margin weakened to 4.40% in FY 2024-25 from 7.61% in the previous year on account of a decline in revenues and market challenges.
margins_costs.quote: During the last financial year, our EBITDA margin weakened on account of a decline in revenues and market challenges.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector and lower price realizations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that a decline in sales growth in standalone as well as consolidated levels failed to offset the challenges posed by global market conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Additionally, decline in sales growth in standalone as well as consolidated levels, has failed to offset the challenges posed by the global market conditions.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed that the second expansion programme of the colour coating manufacturing line is expected to go on stream during the latter part of the current financial year, generating revenues from the last quarter onwards.
management_commitments.quote: This decisive 175% expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues for the Company from the last quarter onwards.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to report a better performance from FY 2025-26 onwards following the commissioning of its new capacities.
management_commitments.quote: The Company expects to report a better performance from FY 2025-26 onwards following the commissioning its new capacities.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
